subject: Acme — POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme — POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the kickoff call today. Wanted to capture the key notes and next steps so we’re aligned going into the pilot: 

Pain points we heard
- High latency and cost on in-house model hosting for realtime chat (95th pct latency spikes during peak)
- Inconsistent quality across multiple prompt variants and user flows; no robust eval harness
- Security/compliance requirements around data residency and audit logs

Pilot goals / success metrics (90-day pilot)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 350ms for single-turn chat (canonical prompt set)
- Cost: reduce per-token serving cost by >= 30% vs current baseline with batching/quantization
- Quality: maintain current user satisfaction (NPS-like metric) with automated evals on sample prompt set
- Reliability: 99.5% availability for the pilot endpoint

Scope / deliverables
- Redwood provides hosted POC endpoint + shared eval harness
- Acme provides representative prompt set (up to 500 prompts) + 10k sample interactions for load testing
- Shared metric dashboard (latency, cost, error rates) + weekly check-ins

Prompt set / evals
- Initial prompt set: Acme will supply 150 representative prompts by 2026-03-06 (see timeline below)
- Redwood will run automatic evals (syntactic correctness, response relevance, hallucination checks) and share reports weekly

Owners
- Acme: Jordan Lee (product), Priya Sharma (engineering), Carlos Rivera (data lead)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Rishi Malhotra (SRE/SE), Neha Kapoor (CS lead)

Timeline (high level)
- 2026-03-02: Kickoff (today) — align scope and owners
- 2026-03-06: Acme delivers initial prompt set + sample dataset
- 2026-03-09: Redwood provides test endpoint + access instructions for S3/DB ingest
- 2026-03-10 to 2026-04-30: Evaluation window (load testing, quality evals, tuning)
- 2026-05-07: Pilot wrap + review; decision on next steps/rollout

Access & setup steps (action items)
1) Acme to share a least-privilege S3 role or temporary creds for test dataset (instructions attached).
2) Acme to upload initial prompt set to the shared Drive folder (link below) by 2026-03-06.
3) Redwood will provision a test endpoint and share API keys and sandbox permissions by 2026-03-09.
4) Rishi will coordinate network/VPN access if needed for private connections.

Attachments
- Acme-POC-MAP-20260302.pdf (POC milestone map)
- Acme-SOW-draft-20260302.docx (SOW for signature; DocuSign link below)

Related links
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cPOC_MAP_SAMPLE
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-98765
- DocuSign (SOW): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&powr=ABCDEFG

Next steps (owners / due dates)
- Jordan / Priya: confirm dataset owner and share S3 role by 2026-03-04
- Acme: upload prompt set by 2026-03-06
- Marissa / Rishi: provision test endpoint by 2026-03-09
- All: weekly sync Friday 10am PT — first sync 2026-03-12

If that all looks correct I’ll send the SOW for signature and Rishi will follow up with the access checklist.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>, Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — very thorough, appreciate the write-up. A couple quick clarifications and one ask from engineering: 

- Data ownership: Carlos will be the technical owner for dataset uploads. Carlos — we’ll share a scoped S3 role, but want to confirm Redwood’s recommended least-privilege permissions so we can coordinate with infra.
- Prompt set: Priya and I will split the 150 prompts across our teams and upload by 2026-03-06. Is there a preferred file format (csv vs jsonl)?
- Evaluation metrics: Can you confirm the exact definition for the hallucination check you mentioned? We want to ensure our baseline evaluation matches yours.

Also — we have a procurement step for PII handling in the pilot. Do you have a preset DPA / SOC2 appendix we can attach to the SOW to expedite legal review?

On the SOW, happy to review the draft. If feasible, can we get a one-page summary of deliverables to attach to the DocuSign packet for our procurement team?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Inc.
jordan.lee@acme.com | (212) 555-0987
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Jordan — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers inline and next actions below: 

- S3 permissions: Recommended minimal permissions will be: s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket scoped to the bucket prefix we’ll use for the pilot. We’ll send a sample IAM policy in the Drive folder (see link). If you prefer temporary creds we can accept pre-signed uploads too. (Rishi to send sample policy)
- Prompt format: JSONL preferred (one prompt per line) — that plays nicely with our eval harness. We’ll accept CSV if that’s easier, but please include a column that maps prompt_id -> prompt_text.
- Hallucination check: our eval flags answers with high-confidence factual assertions that don't match a small ground-truth set. We’ll share the exact rubric in the eval report template (attached in the Drive).
- DPA / SOC2 appendix: Neha attached a SOC2 appendix and standard DPA clause to the SOW draft; we can push as an addendum for your legal team.

Attached / links updated:
- Sample IAM policy: sample-iam-policy.json (in Drive)
- Eval rubric + example reports: eval-rubric-v1.pdf (in Drive)
- One-page deliverables summary: Acme-POC-OnePager.pdf (attached)

Action items updated:
- Rishi: send sample IAM policy + provisioning checklist (by 2026-03-03 EOD)
- Jordan / Carlos / Priya: confirm upload method and owner (by 2026-03-04)
- Marissa: send DocuSign link for SOW once legal confirms appendix (today)

I’ve started the DocuSign flow for the SOW, link below. If you want the one-page attached to the packet I’ll add it now.

DocuSign (SOW): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&powr=ABCDEFG
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cPOC_MAP_SAMPLE

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Priya Sharma <priya@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Carlos and I discussed internally and we’ll: 
- Upload the 150 prompts in JSONL format to the Drive folder by EOD 2026-03-06.
- Carlos will provision a scoped S3 role and share the role ARN with Rishi by 2026-03-04.
- I’ll coordinate with procurement on the SOW; we’ve asked legal to review the SOC2 appendix and DPA and aim to sign the SOW this week.

Please attach the one-page deliverables summary to the DocuSign packet — that will help speed procurement.

Priya
Priya Sharma
Staff Engineer, Acme Inc.
priya@acme.com | (415) 555-7777
summary: POC kickoff recap for Acme Inc. covering pain points (latency, cost, quality), pilot goals and metrics, owners, timeline, access steps, attachments (POC map, SOW), and action items to deliver prompt set and provision S3 access. Legal/SOC2 appendix requested; DocuSign initiated.
